summary: The board removes the secretary who works for {person}.
realLife: Burlington aldermen dismissed Mayor Bernie Sanders’s secretary early in his tenure.
gates: The board has authority to review the appointment of the mayor's secretary.
weights: A close division on the board gives an undecided member more influence.
inGame: needs: authority over the mayor's staff appointment.

turns.what: The secretary remains at the mayor's desk.
turns.pulledBy: The motion to remove the appointee falls short.
turns.writesBack: The vote leaves the appointment in force.

turns.what: The secretary stays until a successor starts.
turns.pulledBy: The council authorizes a transition period.
turns.writesBack: The personnel record gives the last workday.
